name: blog-to-elementor
description: Replicate a user-supplied blog article (saved HTML from any local folder) into a hand-editable WordPress post built with Elementor, restoring title, excerpt, body, date, categories, tags and featured image, localizing images into the media library and shipping desktop/tablet/mobile responsiveness in one pass.

displayName.zh: 博客文章复刻26年11月24日版本

profession.en: Blog Article Replication & WordPress Post Builder

displayDescription.en: Replicate saved blog articles into hand-editable WordPress posts with Elementor, restoring title, date, categories, tags and featured image, localizing images and building three-device responsiveness in one pass.
displayDescription.zh: 把博客文章复刻成可编辑的 WordPress 文章，还原标题日期分类标签特色图，图片本地化适配三端。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我把博客文章的网页 HTML 发给你（存在我自己的任意目录），复刻成 testdecor 后台可手工编辑的 WordPress 文章（post），标题日期分类标签特色图都要，图片传媒体库，直接做好三端响应式
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'll send you a saved blog article HTML file from my own folder. Replicate it into a hand-editable WordPress post on testdecor with title, date, categories, tags and featured image, upload images to the media library, and make it responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile in one pass.

quickPrompts.en: I'll send you a saved blog article HTML file from my own folder. Replicate it into a hand-editable WordPress post on testdecor with title, date, categories, tags and featured image, upload images to the media library, and make it responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile in one pass.
quickPrompts.zh: 我把博客文章的网页 HTML 发给你（存在我自己的任意目录），复刻成 testdecor 后台可手工编辑的 WordPress 文章（post），标题日期分类标签特色图都要，图片传媒体库，直接做好三端响应式

quickPrompts.en: Turn these blog articles into new WordPress posts on a new site address I'll give you, same one-pass responsive build.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这几篇博客文章做成新站点的 WordPress 文章，目标站点我给你地址，同样一次做成响应式

quickPrompts.en: Check the batch of new posts on my site and verify there is no horizontal overflow on mobile, tablet or desktop.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查我后台这批新文章的响应式，确认手机、平板、桌面三端都不横向溢出
